Name: 24-hour format
Author: PrinceLeto
Description:
Changes all in-game texts and UI to use 24-hour format.

This mod uses [url=https://github.com/pardeike/Harmony/]Harmony[/url] to update the code base of the game. It will eventually break with future updates.
Works with multiplayer, though only for players who have it.

Working versions of Stardew Valley:
- 1.3.33
- 1.3.32
- 1.3.28

Both linux and windows version are available. Untested on macOS, you may try the linux version.

This mod use 24-hour format for all languages, except for the map where it only works with English.
Ask me if you want to see more languages supported.

Installation:
- Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]SMAPI[/url]
- Unzip this mod to the mods folder
